title: Corrupt Zygarde
description: Replaces Zygarde's textures with a red (corrupt) version
body:
# Corrupt Zygarde

The Pokémon anime has had it's ups and downs, but fans alike have agreed that Pokémon the Series: XYZ is among one of, if not _the_ best season in the series.

It gave us the most respect we've ever seen for mainline games, let alone ones that felt very rushed and incomplete. The Pokémon X and Y games were alright, but we had legendary moments from the anime.

_One moment in particular from XYZ strikes me:_

![Corrupted Z2, a red version of the Pokémon Zygarde, as seen in Pokémon the Series: XYZ.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/151610aafb6464b7077b6feb863a00430da386eb_0.webp)

I wanted to recreate this within Pixelmon, so I've created: **Corrupt Zygarde**.

It replaces the standard Zygarde 10%, 50%, and Complete Forme textures to be red instead of green.
